bounded_hypotheses.claim: The public BTC/USDT chart may leave a stale last-known price visible without a freshness boundary after market-data loss.
bounded_hypotheses.falsifier: A controlled interruption longer than the observed 42–60 second quote cadence shows a visible stale, delayed, offline, or reconnecting state before the quote exceeds the product freshness threshold.

bounded_hypotheses.claim: Incomplete ChartStore settings may later cause visible candle, indicator, or interaction corruption.
bounded_hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated interaction, symbol/timeframe transition, history-backfill, and reload tests show no visible divergence while the validation errors remain.

confirmed_findings.claim: The published BTC/USDT indicator chart initializes with missing required ChartStore settings on first load and repeats the same validation failure after reload.
confirmed_findings.regression_relation: The January 2026 manual audit reported the same initialization-contract family with different missing ChartStore and IndicatorManager fields.

passed_checks.claim: The public page loaded BTC/USDT metadata, historical bars, and changing quote payloads.
Market-data activity resumed after the bounded short network interruption.
The BTC chart reconstructed after reload, although ChartStore validation errors repeated.

recommended_human_actions: Report the repeated ChartStore required-field initialization failure as a bounded P2 regression.
Do not report stale-price user harm as confirmed from the five-second interruption.
Run three controlled 90–120 second interruptions and record quote age, expected cadence, visible freshness state, and recovery time.
Test out-of-order quote responses and atomic BTC→ETH→BTC transitions in a separately authorized scope.
Keep authenticated workspace, alerts, orders, and trading-decision impact outside this public audit.

subject.scope: public unauthenticated published-indicator chart and quote behavior

unknowns: The five-second network interruption was shorter than the observed approximately 42–60 second public quote cadence, so absence of a stale marker is not yet a confirmed defect.
The authenticated workspace may use a different quote transport, freshness threshold, and recovery policy.
Historical backfill, candle/indicator layer integrity, and duplicate or missing bars were not established.
Symbol and timeframe transition atomicity were not tested on an authorized interactive workspace.
No user-visible trading-decision impact was established for the ChartStore console regression.
verdict_meaning: Present the confirmed ChartStore regression and the bounded freshness hypotheses to an authorized human owner; do not claim stale-price harm, submit externally, execute, or merge automatically.
